description: This file defines the Properties class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, handling document metadata such as creator, title, description, timestamps, and custom properties. It includes methods for setting and retrieving these metadata elements and managing custom property types and conversions.

classes.name: Properties
classes.description: A class managing document metadata such as creator, timestamps, titles, descriptions, and custom properties within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: getCreator
methods.description: Retrieve the creator of the document.

methods.name: setCreator
methods.description: Set the creator of the document.

methods.name: getLastModifiedBy
methods.description: Retrieve who last modified the document.

methods.name: setLastModifiedBy
methods.description: Set who last modified the document.

methods.name: setCreated

methods.name: getModified
methods.description: Get the last modified timestamp.

methods.name: setModified

methods.name: getDescription

methods.name: getSubject

methods.name: setSubject
